items: There are shader builders, shader compilers
inputs: vertex schema, instance schema, varying schema, vertex main logic, fragment main logic, resource binding, injection, Preprocessor flags
Shader Builder : Builds the shader code
Preprocessor :
Injection
resource binding
user customization
After compilation provides the following things:
Vertex layout
Bind group layout entries for group 3
wgsl code
entry points
Geometry
has passes for each pipe line - {String, GeometryPassConfig} map
Geometry subclass can define the passes
geometry can perform operations on shader builder - injections, Preprocessor etc
it also can have resources
Fragment
has passes for each pipe line - {String, MaterialPassConfig} map
Material can perform operations on shader builder - injections, Preprocessor etc
It also define its own bind group layout for group 3
defines pipeline state - blend, cullMode, depthStencil, writeMask, atoc
For entity geometry and matrial are extracted,
perform geometry.process(builder), material.process(builder),
bindgroup layout is made
build pipeline
then cache the pipeline
rest are same as old architecture
